**Narrative 1.0.9** — a free, non-profit tool to build, map and rearrange stories, in English, Português, Español and Français. All your data is stored only on your computer; the app collects no data and no analytics.

The app opens Narrative and keeps itself up to date from https://hvs87.github.io/narrative/ (it works offline after the first start).

**New in 1.0.9:** The privacy notice is now always at the bottom of the start page (as well as in the welcome window and at the end of Settings): a free, non-profit tool, data only on your device or computer, no accounts, ads or statistics, and encrypted sync. (1.0.8 brought pinch-to-zoom, Book and Chapter headers that stay in view, the device’s light or dark mode and separate Books and Chapters tabs on phones.)

| System | File |
|---|---|
| **Windows** | `Narrative-1.0.9-windows-setup.exe` (installer) or `Narrative-1.0.9-windows-portable.exe` (no installation) |
| **macOS** (Intel and Apple silicon) | `Narrative-1.0.9-mac.dmg` |
| **Linux** | `Narrative-1.0.9-linux-x86_64.AppImage` (make it executable and run it) or `.tar.gz` |

The files are not code-signed. **Windows:** on the first start, choose "More info" › "Run anyway". **macOS:** right-click (or Control-click) the app › "Open", then "Open" again; if macOS says the app is damaged, run `xattr -cr /Applications/Narrative.app` in Terminal.

---

**PT:** novidades da 1.0.9: O aviso de privacidade passa a estar sempre no fim da página inicial (além das boas-vindas e do fim das Definições): ferramenta gratuita e sem fins lucrativos, dados só no seu aparelho ou computador, sem contas, publicidade nem estatísticas, e sincronização encriptada. Ferramenta gratuita e sem fins lucrativos, em quatro línguas; todos os dados são unicamente gravados no seu computador. Windows: «Mais informações» › «Executar mesmo assim». macOS: botão direito › «Abrir». Linux: torne o AppImage executável e abra-o.
